observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment owner trace and ECI capability projection

outcome.owner_trace_projection: process-resource delta retained beside the exact scheduled owner execution identity
outcome.interpretation: The trace and ECI layers preserve measured process counters with the owner execution identity and make aggregation loss explicit. The real procfs-backed resources CLI test verifies raw observation on this host. No fresh owner execution was used to produce a live per-owner delta, so operational cost for a running service is not yet read back.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Ambient owner executions lack bounded process-resource evidence
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment resource observation, coherence scheduling, and ECI
pressure_hypothesis.basis: An earlier resident process sample recorded high I/O and memory use but ended before a trace was available, while current owner-pass projections correlated execution IDs and elapsed time without process counters.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Sample the scheduler process around existing owner runners, link deltas to exact service execution IDs, retain a bounded ECI view, and make process and child-process attribution limits explicit.

measurement_limits: Projection readback is covered by deterministic fixture tests, not by a fresh production owner-pass result.
Raw process I/O counters cover the scheduler process only and omit spawned child-process usage.
The feature establishes resource observability, not service causality, effectiveness, or reduced intervention burden.
